block_3_body.tripwire_await_contract: Fail condition / validation probe -> record Tier-0 fault -> complete downgraded step in Safe Mode -> hold DEBUG_STEP_AWAIT until validated state recovery.
block_3_body.live_probe_vs_telemetry_counter_rule: Ambient validate_fn probes called by debug_check_tripwires() evaluate live invariants, active policy bounds, and .rodata ROM parity rather than sticky lifetime error counters; explicit fault handlers invoke debug_trigger_probe() guarded by debug_is_active().
block_3_body.non_awaiting_expected_negative_rule: Expected negative guards (e.g. RO floppy writes, optional file miss) emit LOG_CAT_IO telemetry and DEBUG_REACTION_LOG_AND_CONTINUE / await_on_trigger=false without halting DEBUG_STEP_AWAIT.
block_3_body.layer4_probe_test_linkage: Unit, functional, and integrated suites must connect log_init (LOG_CAT_IO), debug_init, and debug_check_tripwires() alongside explicit DEBUG_STEP_AWAIT -> debug_resolve_await() recovery checks.
block_3_body.non_destructive_audit_rule: Preflight and audit checks must be stack-pure or preserve/restore live state cleanly with zero heap allocation.
block_3_body.pure_types_statutory_text: Functional audits, layout tripwires, and pre-flight routines are declared in
block_3_body.facade_umbrella_statutory_text: Sub-Assembly 4.1: Contract, Input & Cog Verification Cross-References
